case_number: 2025 INSC 290; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S).  OF 2025 [Arising out of SLP (C) Nos. 1970-1971 OF 2023]
summary: Motor vehicle accident claim; issue of driver identity—minor vs. father; reappreciation of evidence warranted in appeal under Article 136; eyewitness and owner testimonies conflicted; findings of Tribunal and High Court upheld; compensation enhanced to Rs. 21,82,800 with 6% interest; 'pay and recover' mechanism confirmed; contributory negligence not proved; minor's involvement rejected based on evidence; death due to rash and negligent driving; sole breadwinner status established; dependency of widow, disabled son, and elderly mother recognized.
legal_provisions_cited: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 s.5, s.4, s.180, s.181, s.184
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment of High Court upheld; compensation as awarded sustained.
